001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv;
002
003import com.opencsv.CSVReader;
004import com.opencsv.CSVWriter;
005import com.opencsv.exceptions.CsvValidationException;
006import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
007import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
008import com.streamconverter.path.CSVPath;
009import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
010import java.io.IOException;
011import java.io.InputStream;
012import java.io.InputStreamReader;
013import java.io.OutputStream;
014import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
015import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
016
017/**
018 * CSV Navigate Command Class
019 *
020 * <p>This class implements command for targeted CSV transformation using column selectors. It
021 * identifies specific columns using column names or indices and applies IRule transformations to
022 * those columns while preserving the overall CSV structure.
023 */
024public class CsvNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
025
026  private final CSVPath columnSelector;
027  private final IRule rule;
028
029  /**
030   * Constructor for CSV navigation with typed column selector and transformation rule.
031   *
032   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to select column
033   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column
034   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector or rule is null
035   */
036  private CsvNavigateCommand(CSVPath columnSelector, IRule rule) {
037    this.columnSelector = columnSelector;
038    this.rule = rule;
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Constructor for CSV navigation with TreePath (for compatibility).
043   *
044   * @param treePath the TreePath representing column selector
045   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column
046   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
047   */
048  private CsvNavigateCommand(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
049    this.columnSelector = CSVPath.of(treePath.toString());
050    this.rule = rule;
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Factory method for creating a CSV navigation command with typed column selector and rule.
055   *
056   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to select column
057   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column data
058   * @return a CsvNavigateCommand that extracts the specified column with the given rule
059   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector or rule is null
060   */
061  public static CsvNavigateCommand create(CSVPath columnSelector, IRule rule) {
062    if (columnSelector == null) {
063      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null");
064    }
065    if (rule == null) {
066      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
067    }
068    return new CsvNavigateCommand(columnSelector, rule);
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Factory method for creating a CSV navigation command with TreePath compatibility.
073   *
074   * @param treePath the TreePath representing column selector
075   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column data
076   * @return a CsvNavigateCommand that extracts the specified column with the given rule
077   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
078   */
079  public static CsvNavigateCommand create(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
080    if (treePath == null) {
081      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
082    }
083    if (rule == null) {
084      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
085    }
086    return new CsvNavigateCommand(treePath, rule);
087  }
088
089  @Override
090  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
091    try (CSVReader csvReader =
092            new CSVReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
093        CSVWriter csvWriter =
094            new CSVWriter(
095                new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
096                CSVWriter.DEFAULT_SEPARATOR,
097                CSVWriter.DEFAULT_QUOTE_CHARACTER,
098                // RFC 4180 §5: only doubled-quote escaping, no backslash escape
099                CSVWriter.NO_ESCAPE_CHARACTER,
100                // RFC4180_LINE_END (\r\n) per RFC 4180 §2.
101                CSVWriter.RFC4180_LINE_END)) {
102
103      applyRuleToColumn(csvReader, csvWriter);
104
105    } catch (CsvValidationException e) {
106      throw new IOException("Failed to parse CSV: " + e.getMessage(), e);
107    }
108  }
109
110  /** Apply transformation rule to specific column while preserving CSV structure */
111  private void applyRuleToColumn(CSVReader csvReader, CSVWriter csvWriter)
112      throws IOException, CsvValidationException {
113    String[] headers = csvReader.readNext();
114    if (headers == null) {
115      return; // Empty input
116    }
117
118    // Determine column index
119    int columnIndex = resolveColumnIndex(headers, columnSelector);
120    if (columnIndex == -1) {
121      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column not found: " + columnSelector.toString());
122    }
123
124    // Write header (unchanged); applyQuotesToAll=false: only quote when RFC 4180 requires
125    csvWriter.writeNext(headers, false);
126
127    // Process data rows
128    String[] row;
129    // Read and transform each data row until the CSV reader reaches EOF.
130    while ((row = csvReader.readNext()) != null) {
131      if (columnIndex < row.length) {
132        // Apply rule to target column only
133        row[columnIndex] = rule.apply(row[columnIndex]);
134      }
135      // applyQuotesToAll=false: only quote fields that contain delimiters or quotes
136      csvWriter.writeNext(row, false);
137    }
138    csvWriter.flush();
139  }
140
141  /** Resolve column index using CSVPath matches() method */
142  private int resolveColumnIndex(String[] headers, CSVPath csvPath) {
143    for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
144      if (csvPath.matches(headers, i)) {
145        return i;
146      }
147    }
148    return -1; // Not found
149  }
150}
